$comment: A prospect profile. One file per prospect; the seeder builds an entire
agency from it. Nothing here is real: the portfolio, the people and the
money are invented to be plausible at this scale, and the only true things
are the agency's name and the portfolio size they told us.
Every date is expressed as an offset from the run, never a literal, so the
world is current whenever it is seeded. A demo with last March's invoices
on screen is the detail that loses the room.

agency.name: Midnight Masquerade
agency.addressText: 2nd Floor, The Foundry, Prestwich Street, Green Point, Cape Town, 8005

branding.$comment: Locare's own palette is the default. Replace brand/tint with theirs once we have the logo; logo is a path under demo/assets/ and may be null.

subscription.$comment: 500 units is past GROWTH_MAX_UNITS (499), so this is a Custom-tier conversation by the platform's own maths — not a sales posture. unitRateCents is read from CUSTOM_UNIT_RATE when left null.

portfolio.$comment: 500 units across a believable Cape Town spread: a few large blocks carry the bulk, a long tail of small buildings and houses makes up the rest. The seeder generates units to hit `units` exactly.

people.$comment: Staff and the two app logins. Addresses are on the demo domain so Mailpit catches everything; the ones marked `watch` are the mailboxes opened on screen during the demo.

story.$comment: The handful of records that get opened on screen. Everything else is generated filler that only has to survive a scroll; these have to survive a click.

history.$comment: How much past to generate. Twelve months gives the reports something to draw and makes the account look lived-in rather than created this morning.
